answer_raw:
The current federal funds target range is **3.75% to 4.00%** as of September 2026 [2][4]. On October 21, 2026, the effective federal funds rate was reported at **3.88%** [2].

At its most recent meeting on September 16, 2026, the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) raised the benchmark interest rate by **25 basis points** to reach the current target range [2]. Following that decision, the Board of Governors voted to raise the interest rate paid on reserve balances to **3.90%**, effective September 17, 2026 [2].

While the September hike is the most recent action, the Fed is currently facing persistent inflation—with a September 2026 CPI report showing prices rose 3.7% year over year—leading to speculation that another hike could occur at the upcoming October 28 or December 9 meetings [7].
